name: Matzah Lasagne
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 30–34 ounces marinara sauce or tomato sauce

steps: Grease a baking pan that will fit the matzah sheets.
Spread about ½ cup sauce in the pan to cover the bottom.
Spread more tomato sauce over the matzah.
Spread a layer of cottage cheese on top of the matzah.
Sprinkle with mozzarella and Parmesan cheeses.
Repeat these layers until all 4 matzah sheets are used.
Spread tomato sauce and sprinkle mozzarella and Parmesan cheese on top.
Cover with foil, and bake at 350°F (175°C) for 35–40 minutes.
